scope: Grammar Mondai 1, printed questions 1 and 11; full-exam question IDs 36 and 46.

source.method: Read the PDF text layer and visually inspected pages 5–6 in Chrome.
source.provenanceQualification: The Drive PDF directly supports the printed wording and choices. Its publication provenance was not independently established, and it contains no answer key.

answerKeyLimitation: The source exam PDF does not include an answer key. Two answer tables already recorded in answer-key-2022-12-grammar.json disagree on both items; the linguistically reviewed option is retained, but is not certified as the official JLPT key.

questions.sourcePrompt: （教室で）アン「先生、スピーチ大会の申込書を書いてきました。書き方がよくわからないところがあったんですが、ここの書き方はこれ（　）大丈夫でしょうか。」
questions.linguisticReview: Option 2, これで大丈夫, naturally asks whether this way of filling in the form is acceptable. The two recorded answer tables instead give options 3 and 4.

questions.sourcePrompt: （電話で）山下「はい、X 建設営業課、山下です。」石田「ABC 銀行の石田と申しますが、中川さんか林さんはいらっしゃいますか。」山下「はい、中川が（　）ので、今、代わります。」
questions.linguisticReview: Option 2, おります, is the humble form of いる and fits an employee saying that a colleague is present. Neither recorded answer table gives option 2.
